tasks.description: Provide one bounded permanent-owner reconciliation of pending care through existing outbox/sync, independent of an open card or manual Retry button.
constraints: Read-only acceptance of controller-authored candidate after repeated provider transport timeouts. Parent controller prepared production patch (SyncEngine/Repository) and compact6tests outside active checkout at09774b8, child inspected every hunk, git apply --check PASS and applied only3Swift paths after UIcd517028 acceptance. This is explicitly NOT a successful Developer call: verify full actual candidate delta from cd517028, actual new gates and independent Review/QA. Terminal generic post-save behavior stays unchanged. No full stage1/T* closure from this core-only seam.

Implement only a lifecycle-independent owner-bound care reconciliation seam for later Root wiring. Do not add UI, new queue/schema, Today, notifications, source data, billing, new server endpoint or timer loop. Reuse current LocalOutboxRecord, SyncEngine ordered drain, typed receipts/canonical ACK and owner delta/full refresh. No new sync protocol.

Concrete gap: current reconnect/card reopen retries only manual date/undo, while routine completion/undo, firstaid record/observe/photo, basic enable/refresh remain pending until explicit Retry. The new seam can be called on foreground/reconnect with one captured permanent bound lease and must deliver eligible current-owner care pending and refresh canonical data without a create receipt, rule/profile or paid precondition for manual record.

Preserve existing per-plant sequence, deletion blocking, GlobalChainBlocked and drainingOwners guard. Do not loop over exact flushPlantCommand calls in a way that bypasses an earlier still-pending operation for the same plant. Prefer a small wrapper/filter/mode on the existing drain if needed. Profile reminder-hour pending can reuse its existing typed handler. Do not activate retired slots/report/season/AI commands, resend another owner, or trigger new analyses. Include the existing typed PlantEditCommand handler for owner changes/rename so a restored offline condition edit can clear before its later care operation; do not introduce a new edit format or bypass its canonical verification.

Care-only filtering must not silently skip a preceding unsupported pending write and then send a later same-plant care command: mark that plant blocked for this pass. Existing pending deletion blocks its other commands even if deletion is outside the care-only subset. Keep unrelated owner/global work untouched; recognized profile-hour may use its existing handler. Return explicit busy/incomplete rather than implying full drain if another owner pass holds drainingOwners.

All successful visible state comes from existing canonical receipt/linkage checks. Pending response loss, offline and failed sync retain exact commands; permanent manual record rejection must not become false success or endless immediate retries. If adapting its terminal behavior, scope it to the new explicit care reconciliation path and preserve post-save no-false-success semantics. Do not treat committed count or disappearance as an action confirmation.

Use one bounded attempt per trigger, coalescing/reentrancy handled without duplicate sends. No periodic polling or retry-forever task. Stale lease/auth ABA/cancellation abort safely and preserve original owner queue; a fresh same-owner lease can later finish. An expired/paused account may still deliver valid manual watering/correct/undo; it must not invent resumed automated checks. No network or applicability loader is needed to persist care offline.

Add compact meaningful tests using existing helpers/transports. Prove a disk-restored care queue automatically drains without calling action-specific UI retry; reuse accepted manual/routine/firstaid fixture structures rather than hundreds of repeated JSON lines. Exercise representative manual + routine/firstaid + profile-hour, response loss/exact retry and owner-switch/cancellation. Preserve all previous tests and never weaken canonical proof or claim live/iPhone acceptance. Include ordering regression: pending typed condition edit then care makes forward progress on reconnect; an unsupported earlier same-plant command still blocks later care.

acceptance_criteria.description: Build and full Swift tests pass; restored owner care pending can be reconciled by one common method without manual UI Retry, with exact identity and preserved ordering.
Ordinary Simulator smoke passes; independent Review/QA verify bounded retry, isolation, expiry/manual access and preserved receipts.
